title: Validation of an ecological interface for teaching diabetes risk factors
summary: The study examines how healthcare professionals’ understanding of cardiovascular disease risk changes when risk information is presented in different formats (a new visualization-based interface, a standard online risk calculator, or a written mock clinical/laboratory report). It assesses how well participants identify the most important risk factors.

interventions.name: To answer five case vignettes, participants will be provided with an interface developed according to principles of ecological interface design, which displays information about diabetes risk and the composition of that risk for each respective case.
To answer five case vignettes, participants will be provided with a standard interface that displays information about diabetes risk for each respective case.
To answer five case vignettes, participants will be provided with a laboratory report that includes the parameters used to determine the individual diabetes risk.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Fluent in English
- Diagnosed with diabetes
- Increased risk for diabetes (e.g., pre diabetes)
Exclusion criteria:
- Not fluent in English
- No increased risk for diabetes and not diagnosed with diabetes
